candidate_storage.status: Earlier extraction retained; C GeoJSON publication deferred

publication_note: The C_balanced 3D models contain 54,014 candidates. Candidate and review GeoJSON updates are deferred in this release; the existing GeoJSON files retain the earlier extraction and do not match the updated centre models. The viewer reads GLB metadata and does not require the candidate GeoJSON.
